title: In a cloud session, the guard refuses a gh write outside the merge tool
why: Lane reviewer-no-session-tools (session_013NEJKzc39M5wFtru1uU5u4), 07:33 CST Nov 9: it read a PR body with `gh api repos/.../pulls/1674`. The cloud system prompt says gh is for search only, and reads and writes go through the GitHub MCP tools; no guard refused it. Harm: a gh write (a PR merge or comment) skips the MCP route's footer and the merge checks.
note: Narrowed (coordinator, 08:00 CST Nov 9), before any lane starts: a gh read is harmless, and this session, the batch runners and the merge tool read PRs with `gh api` all day, so refusing reads would be a false alarm on every wake. Scope: in a cloud session, refuse a gh write outside the merge tool: the `gh pr` subcommands for creating, merging, commenting, editing, closing and reviewing; the `gh issue` subcommands for commenting and creating; and `gh api` with -X/--method POST, PATCH, PUT or DELETE, or a -f/-F field, on a non-search route. Search and all reads stay allowed. The remedy names the MCP tool. A local session keeps gh. Related: steps mcp-merge-unguarded and mcp-merge-role. Slug kept (step files are never renamed). Cleared to start; the coordinator starts its lane. Filed 07:59 CST Nov 9. Lane session_013NEJKzhQbKBYLydFg93MHt started 08:01 CST Nov 9 (coordinator); the heredoc false alarm triage hit is a test row in its brief.
